notes: Source fields are trigger, interrupt, and formation descriptions; they are not validated positive/negative behavioral indicators.
Do not infer hidden intent from a trigger description alone.
Victim / Judge source entry is shared and is not eligible for individual candidate scoring.
Missing entries remain unscored behaviorally; never synthesize definitions.

behavior.interrupt: Say the full yes or the full no. No bargains with the universe.
behavior.forms: Bargaining at the cost of integrity. Middle ground as escape from the binary. Forms when full commitment was punished.

behavior.trigger: Uncertainty. Lack of visible outcome path.
behavior.interrupt: Release grip for 3 breaths. Observe what happens without intervention. The field holds.
behavior.forms: Solar plexus charge from early powerlessness. The child who could not influence outcome over-corrects as adult. Forms when care turns to command.

behavior.trigger: Outcome not going the way it should. Others' behavior disappointing.
behavior.interrupt: Take the mirror. Where in me is this exact pattern operating? Claim that first.
behavior.forms: Shadow pairing. The judge protects the victim by externalizing responsibility. Forms when accountability was punished instead of supported.

behavior.interrupt: Ship at 85%. Watch the nervous system not die.
behavior.forms: Variant of Stickler + Hyper-Achiever. Flawless output as defense against criticism at the self-level. Forms when mistakes meant loss of worth.

behavior.trigger: Someone else's disappointment, need, or displeasure.
behavior.interrupt: Pause before yes. Ask: whose need am I solving right now?
behavior.forms: Heart-sacral entanglement. Approval became a survival strategy. Forms when boundaries were punished.

behavior.interrupt: Sit down with empty hands. Five minutes. No metric. Observe the resistance that rises.
behavior.forms: Solar plexus compensation for root-level worthlessness. Performance becomes proof of right to exist. Forms when love was conditional on output.

behavior.trigger: Emotional signal in self or others.
behavior.interrupt: Drop from head into body. Name the sensation before naming the analysis. Let the feeling be data.
behavior.forms: Third eye over-activation to escape heart-level overwhelm. The body left the felt sense when felt sense was too much. Forms in children who had to manage adult emotional environments.

behavior.trigger: Novelty. Environment shifting. Others' moods changing.
behavior.interrupt: Anchor to one breath at a time. Name what is actually present. Separate actual threat from pattern-match.
behavior.forms: Amygdala wiring set in early environment where threat was unpredictable. The nervous system never stood down. Forms when safety was intermittent.

behavior.interrupt: Stay with the discomfort of arrival. The body will try to launch the next project. Do not.
behavior.forms: Root-level unsafety with the present moment. Motion was the escape hatch from being felt. Forms when being still meant being seen.

behavior.interrupt: Ask: is this a structural fault or a preference? Release what is preference.
behavior.forms: Rigidity as armor against early chaos. Order was safety when order was scarce. Forms when unpredictability was threat.

behavior.trigger: Outcome not going the way it should. Others' behavior disappointing.
behavior.interrupt: Take the mirror. Where in me is this exact pattern operating? Claim that first.
behavior.forms: Shadow pairing. The judge protects the victim by externalizing responsibility. Forms when accountability was punished instead of supported.

behavior.interrupt: Stay with what was said about you before redirecting. Thirty seconds.
behavior.forms: Heart-throat shield. Redirect attention off of self at the moment of exposure. Forms when accountability came with attack.

behavior.interrupt: Signal at true amplitude. If signal is small, deliver it small. The audience can handle it.
behavior.forms: Sacral-throat amplification. Volume became the only reliable way to be registered. Forms when the measured voice was ignored.

behavior.interrupt: Play the feared outcome fully to its end. The body discovers it survives there.
behavior.forms: Anticipatory rehearsal of pain as attempt to control the uncontrollable. Forms when sudden bad news was a pattern.

behavior.interrupt: Stay in one relational moment past your usual exit point.
behavior.forms: Sacral-heart contraction. Isolation as safety after relational harm. Forms when being close meant being hurt.

behavior.interrupt: Speak one true thing that risks disapproval. Small. Specific.
behavior.forms: Pleaser at performance level. Approval through visible accomplishment rather than accommodation. Forms when attention was food.

behavior.interrupt: Test the smallest version first. Let the evidence arrive. Withhold the closure.
behavior.forms: Third eye compensating for early betrayal at the heart level. Disbelief as armor against being fooled again.

behavior.interrupt: One small action in the present that takes you toward the dream. Not the plan. The action.
behavior.forms: Crown-sacral escape into projected future. Present becomes the thing to survive until the future arrives. Forms when the present was consistently unsatisfying.

behavior.interrupt: Start for 5 minutes with no obligation to continue. Usually the body keeps going.
behavior.forms: Fear of the outcome test. Better to not do than to do and fail. Forms when effort was measured and rejected.

behavior.interrupt: Name three pieces of evidence for your competence out loud. Let the facts land.
behavior.forms: Crown-heart disconnect. Self-concept lagging behind actual capability. Forms when competence was dismissed or undervalued early.

behavior.interrupt: Step back half a foot physically. Lower the voice. Let the charge settle in the body first.
behavior.forms: Solar plexus pre-emptive strike. Attack before being attacked. Forms when defense was required early and often.

behavior.interrupt: Receive help offered. Let someone else carry their part. Feel the cost of being supported.
behavior.forms: Sacrifice as claim to moral authority. Pain becomes identity currency. Forms when only suffering earned recognition.

behavior.interrupt: Let them be earnest without commentary. Observe what the cynic was protecting.
behavior.forms: Contempt as armor around a caring that was wounded. The seeker who stopped seeking. Forms after repeated disillusionment.

behavior.interrupt: Ask directly. Risk a no. Let the other person have their actual response.
behavior.forms: Root-solar strategy from early environment where direct ask was blocked. Indirection became the only channel. Forms when straightforward need was punished.

behavior.interrupt: Decide in the body. Body votes with a weight or a lightness. Go with the body.
behavior.forms: Third eye over-activation as substitute for decisive action. Analysis fills the void where the trusted body-read should be. Forms when body signals were trained to be ignored.

behavior.interrupt: Stay in the room. Stay in the body. Breathe once. Look at one actual object in the space.
behavior.forms: Dissociation as survival. Crown-level exit when body-level presence was not safe. Forms with trauma that could not be fought.

behavior.interrupt: Name one thing you would mourn losing. That is meaning. You already have it.
behavior.forms: Meaninglessness as shield against caring being wounded again. Forms after repeated disillusionment with promised meaning.

behavior.interrupt: Name what you would lose if the hoped-for thing actually happened. Often the fear lives there.
behavior.forms: Pre-emptive disappointment. Lowering expectation as armor against letdown. Forms when hope was reliably broken.

behavior.interrupt: Run the scale: on a 1-10, what is this actually? Ground in proportion.
behavior.forms: Solar plexus runaway amplification. Survival software over-firing on noise. Forms when small signals preceded actual catastrophe repeatedly.

behavior.trigger: Conflict approaching or difficult task surfacing.
behavior.interrupt: Name the task, break it to the smallest next action, move that action within 60 seconds.
behavior.forms: Fear fetters at the root activate. The body prefers flight. Becomes a character when flight is rewarded by environment repeatedly.
